record.paper: Triangle Ramsey numbers of complete graphs

dossier_meta.paper: Triangle Ramsey numbers of complete graphs
dossier_meta.context_text: Motivated by a question of Sam Spiro asking whether an analogue of Chvatal's theorem holds for $r_{K_s}(K_t)$, the authors conjecture that the complete graph on $r(K_t)$ vertices minimises the number of $K_s$ copies among all $K_t$-Ramsey graphs. The paper verifies this conjecture for $s = 3$ and all sufficiently large $t$ as its main result (Theorem 1.3).
